response.overview: Born for the Ring is a coming-of-age sports drama about Joi, a 12-year-old Muay Thai fighter who enters the ring to help support his struggling mother. Despite his small size and limited experience, his determination catches the attention of a boxing coach, who teaches him that being a fighter is not only about physical strength, but also discipline, patience, courage, and heart.  As Joi prepares for the biggest fight of his life, he must overcome fear, pressure, and self-doubt. Through his journey, he discovers that the most important opponent is not the person standing across the ring, but himself.  Born for the Ring is a story about family, sacrifice, perseverance, and the true meaning of victory.
response.title: BORN FOR THE RING
